answer: A summit commit-reveal bond blocks bulk fakes. Each agent locks 60, posts a hash of a timber delivery on a summit board, then reveals it; a beacon check links the revealed delivery to the hash; mismatch burns the bond. Each fake needs a fresh delivery, 60 plus 35, so 1,000 fakes cost 95,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented deliveries fail the beacon check: the hash binds the delivery to its key. Honest agents pay 60 once, refunded on clean reveal.
